result.instructions: Routing mode: standard. Calls that name nothing use perplexity/sonar with web search. Pass `depth` (fast, low or medium) to use a Perplexity preset instead, or `model` to name any model id; an explicit model is always used exactly as given. Pass only one of `tier`, `depth` and `model` per call. Override the default only when the user asks. Depths high and xhigh belong to perplexity_research.
